related.title: 晶矽太陽電池模組製造

related.transferEn: Both require IV, thermal and packaging validation
related.difference: 單片劃線串聯取代矽電池焊帶
practice: 以「材料選擇」為起點，畫出本課與「晶矽太陽電池模組製造」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。

practiceEn: Start from material selection and mark shared/redefined boundaries with crystalline-silicon solar-module manufacturing.
For the difference "Monolithic scribes replace silicon-cell ribbons", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.
